AU: On iPhone and Android, a `<dialog>` and the `modal` family are drawn as a bottom sheet by default: the panel slides up from the bottom edge, the grab handle and swipe-to-close included. The author's CSS on the dialog or on `modal.content` (for example `margin: auto` or `inset`) overrides that placement. An alert dialog (`<modal.root alert>` or `<dialog role="alertdialog">`) stays a centered box. The `drawer` family is a bottom sheet on every platform. On the website, `<dialog>` and `modal` are centered boxes.
LI: `<dialog>` and the `modal` family are centered boxes on every platform, iPhone and Android included. The `drawer` family is a panel that slides in from the bottom edge (a bottom sheet) on every platform. Choose the one you want.
